guideline: For TSS_h: show 5 exemplars each for source and target styles, ask annotator to select which style the transferred text belongs to (binary scoring)
For MS_h and F_h: use three-level Likert scale (0-2) halved to 0-1 range for meaning similarity and fluency judgments
Annotators are asked to judge target style strength (TSS_h), meaning similarity (MS_h), and fluency (F_h) using exemplars and Likert‑scale questions.

For TSS h , we show 5 exemplars for the style of the input text and 5 exemplars for the target style, and ask the annotator to select the style of the transferred text out of these two styles. For MS h and F h , we ask whether the transferred text has a similar meaning to the input text and whether the transferred is fluent, respectively, and collect the answers using a three-level Likert scale ranging from 0 to 2, which is then halved to fit in the 0 to 1 range.
